messages:
maya: Heads up — eval CI failed on bring-up for q4-runner with a weird shard checksum mismatch. seen in two different shards in the same job. full failure log attached in the CI artifact: https://ci.internal/reds/12345 :thinking_face:

arjun: saw the CI alert. quick skim shows dataset split hashes differ across runner replicas during the synthetic promptset stage. error looks like `Shard checksum mismatch: expected 0x9f4a, got 0x2b7d`

maya: yup. reproducer locally is flaky — sometimes passes, sometimes fails. i suspect deterministic fixtures or RNG seeding isn't consistent across shards.

dana: could be the synthetic generator using system clock to seed when running in parallel. we had that once with the paraphrase fixture.

arjun: digging into the runner code — in runner/fixtures/synth_gen.py we only seed in the master path. shards call `generate_shard()` which currently does: ```python
# synth_gen.py (excerpt)
def generate_shard(seed=None):
    if seed is None:
        seed = int(time.time() * 1e6)  # BAD: wallclock-based seeding
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    ...
```

arjun: so every shard running concurrently will get different implicit seeds. CI sometimes runs serially so we didn't catch it earlier.

maya: that explains nondet. any chance kv-cache usage or quantization path affects this? i noticed the failing job used the quantized runner image.

arjun: quantization shouldn't change seed behavior but it can change timing which makes wallclock seeding worse.

eval-bot: test-summary: job=eval-harness/bringup-quantized runner= q4-runner shards=4 failures=2 flakes=1 logs=/artifacts/12345

dana: proposed fix: require explicit seed in CI job matrix and plumb deterministic seed into every shard invocation. also change generate_shard() default to raise if seed is None so tests fail loudly.

maya: +1. would also like a unit test that runs multiple shards in parallel with the same seed and asserts identical split checksums. add to runner unit tests.

arjun: i'll open a PR. plan: 1) change default behavior (raise on None), 2) update CI job to pass SEED env var in matrix, 3) add unit test `test_shard_determinism`. patch draft: ```diff
diff --git a/runner/fixtures/synth_gen.py b/runner/fixtures/synth_gen.py
@@
-def generate_shard(seed=None):
-    if seed is None:
-        seed = int(time.time() * 1e6)
+def generate_shard(seed):
+    if seed is None:
+        raise ValueError("generate_shard requires explicit seed for deterministic tests")
```

arjun: also adding a small smoke check in CI that runs `python -m runner.tests.test_shard_determinism` before the big matrix. keeps expensive runs gated.

maya: can we also emit the seed used into the eval metadata so failing jobs show it in dashboard? that'll speed root cause.

arjun: sure — will add `env['EVAL_SEED']=seed` and logger line.

dana: after this we should sweep other synthetic generators and promptset serializers for implicit randomness. i'll run a grep for `time.time` or `uuid4()` uses in the synth/ and promptset/ dirs.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: CI change approved by infra, staging pipeline will run the smoke check. ETA: ~2 hours. :rocket:

maya: awesome. once PR lands, i'll re-run the quantized bring-up and check metric diffs (latency + pass@1) to ensure no regression introduced by deterministic plumbing.

arjun: PR: https://git.internal/reds/p/456 — tests added, CI matrix updated. requesting review from @maya and @dana.

maya: reviewing now. spotted small doc blip in `docs/eval/fixtures.md` where we mention implicit seeding; will update to require explicit seed for reproducible runs.

dana: grep found two other places using `uuid.uuid4()` to name temp files in promptset generation — replacing with hashed deterministic names using the seed. adding that to PR.

maya: thanks. after merge let's add a dashboard alert that flags high shard checksum variance across replicas (simple stdev on the split hash values). if stdev > 0 then fire. helps catch regressions early.

arjun: will add metric `eval.shard_checksum_stdev` and a Grafana panel.

eval-bot: follow-up: job rerun on staging passed for 3/3 smoke runs. full matrix scheduled.

maya: great work. keeping this thread for the checklist: update docs, merge PR, add unit test, dashboard panel, CI smoke gate. ping me when green. :thumbsup:
